verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business telephony service with some AI features, such as AI-assisted note-taking, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it accepts MCP servers. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use tools from MCP servers. The documentation covers only numbers, porting, ring groups, auto attendants and reporting, and the probes found no machine-readable developer surfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
